process.pdk_version_source: ciel versions/22f43352dd8219f9007eb659e422e0d5fe28c5fb of ihp-sg13, which ihp-sg13cmos5l links to

limitations: a pad frame: the layout holds the bond pads and the die area and nothing else; no circuit stands behind any pad
each pad's net, direction and role are the frame spec's word, not a circuit's; a pad's name is its port and its net
no DRC, antenna or LVS ran on this layout; checks is empty because no count was taken, which is not a count of zero
pad positions are the frame spec's, checked only against the die outline, the grid and the other pads' plates, not against any design rule
the pad master is the --pad-gds cell, checked only for its plate, its opening and its extent; everything else it draws is copied as given
pdk_version is read as pdk_version_source says, when this record was written; nothing was built with the PDK
